name: Experiment 0001 — coverage gold set
corpus: 34 hospital policy PDFs + 28 Joint Commission standards
task: For each documentation-required Element of Performance, do the supplied policies cover it?

label_definitions.COVERED: A policy provision substantively satisfies what the EP requires. Must cite evidence.
label_definitions.PARTIAL: Some of what the EP requires is addressed; a stated part is not. Must cite evidence AND name what is missing.
label_definitions.NOT_COVERED: Nothing in the 34 supplied policies addresses this. Must record the search terms tried, so the absence claim is auditable.

caveat: Labelled by the same agent that wrote the pipeline. Founder review is the real control; until then a passing score means 'the pipeline agrees with me', not 'the pipeline is right'. Frozen before the adjudicator was written.

labels.label: PARTIAL
labels.missing: EP requires the program document to include leadership structure and program accountability. The policy establishes risk assessment and EOP content but names no leadership structure or accountable owner.
labels.notes: Vocabulary distance: policy says 'all-hazards risk assessment', EP says 'comprehensive emergency management program'.

labels.label: PARTIAL
labels.missing: EP requires a facility-based HVA covering enumerated hazard categories. The policy requires an all-hazards risk assessment naming five example event types, but does not require the facility-based scope or the full category list.
labels.notes: Decoy N3. The term 'hazard vulnerability analysis' never appears in the policy corpus; a lexical matcher cannot find this.

labels.label: COVERED
labels.notes: Policy explicitly requires an EOP with procedures for evacuation, sheltering, staff roles, continuity.

labels.label: PARTIAL
labels.missing: EP requires a maintained contact list spanning staff, physicians, volunteers, entities providing services under arrangement, and federal/state/local emergency preparedness staff. Policy requires notification procedures and external agency contact information only.

labels.label: PARTIAL
labels.missing: EP requires a staffing plan specific to emergency duration and patient surge. Policy addresses staff roles and volunteer management within the EOP but establishes no emergency/surge staffing plan.
labels.notes: Near-miss decoy: 'Staffing and Delivery of Care §1' is a general staffing plan and must NOT be counted as coverage — it does not address emergencies or surge.

labels.label: NOT_COVERED
labels.missing: Alternate energy sources for temperature maintenance, emergency lighting, fire detection/alarm/extinguishing, and sewage/waste disposal.
labels.notes: Searched: alternate energy, emergency power, generator, fuel, utility systems, emergency lighting. 'Environment of Care - Hazardous Materials §4' covers fire prevention, not alternate energy sources.

labels.label: PARTIAL
labels.missing: EP requires a distinct written continuity of operations plan developed with named executive, business, and finance leader participation. Policy mentions continuity of essential services as one EOP procedure only.
labels.notes: Labelled PARTIAL rather than NOT_COVERED deliberately: related substance exists, and overstating absence is the failure mode this experiment is built to catch.

labels.label: NOT_COVERED
labels.missing: Initial emergency management education and training for new and existing staff, contractors, and volunteers, covering EOP activation, communications plan, evacuation/shelter/lockdown/surge, and resource acquisition.
labels.notes: Strong decoy. 'Emergency Preparedness - Disaster Plan §4' is titled 'Training and Testing' and will rank first lexically, but its content is exercise testing twice annually — not initial staff education. Counting it as coverage is a false positive.

labels.label: COVERED
labels.notes: Two exercises annually, one full-scale, community partners involved. Close match in both substance and vocabulary.

labels.label: PARTIAL
labels.missing: EP assigns review and evaluation to a multidisciplinary committee overseeing the emergency management program. Policy requires after-action review and EOP update but names no committee or oversight body.

labels.label: COVERED
labels.notes: B0 failure case: BM25's top three are Hazardous Materials, Antibiotic Stewardship, and Workplace Violence. The correct policy does not appear at all.

labels.label: COVERED
labels.notes: Vocabulary aligns closely; B0 ranks this first by a wide margin. Included as a case where lexical retrieval should succeed.

labels.label: PARTIAL
labels.missing: EP addresses staff communicable disease exposure: immunization, exposure evaluation and follow-up, and work restrictions for infected staff. Corpus has PPE only; there is no occupational/employee health policy.
labels.notes: Corpus infection control is patient-directed; the EP is staff-directed.

labels.label: NOT_COVERED
labels.missing: Retention of records of source and disposition of all blood units for at least 10 years with prompt retrieval.
labels.notes: Searched: retention, record, 10 years, disposition, source, traceability. The Blood and Blood Product Administration policy has no retention provision.

labels.label: COVERED
labels.notes: Major B0 failure case: BM25's top three are Emergency Preparedness, Blood Bank Inventory, and Informed Consent. The Medication Administration policy — five rights, high-alert double-checks, adverse drug event reporting, P&T oversight — does not appear.

labels.label: COVERED
labels.notes: B0 ranks the correct policy third with a weak score.

labels.label: NOT_COVERED
labels.missing: A maintained list of all contracted services including scope and nature of services provided.
labels.notes: Searched: contracted services, list, inventory, scope, nature, agreement. The Credentialing and Supervision of Contract Staff policy governs credentialing of contract practitioners; it does not require a services inventory. Nearest-neighbour trap: high lexical overlap on 'contract'.

labels.label: PARTIAL
labels.missing: EP makes the governing body responsible for all services including contracted services, with assessment and corrective action. Policy establishes governing body oversight of QAPI results generally, not responsibility for contracted services.

labels.label: NOT_COVERED
labels.missing: Governing body approval of and responsibility for the grievance process, review and resolution of grievances, or written delegation to a grievance committee.
labels.notes: Searched: grievance, complaint, governing body, patient concern. The Patient Rights policy contains no grievance provision.

labels.label: NOT_COVERED
labels.missing: An institutional plan containing an annual operating budget and a three-year capital expenditure plan, reviewed annually.
labels.notes: Searched: budget, capital expenditure, institutional plan, financial. No financial planning content exists anywhere in the corpus.
